paper_title: Constraints on axionlike particles from a combined analysis of three flaring $\textit{Fermi}$ flat-spectrum radio quasars
notes: Blazar jet ALP-photon mixing search with Fermi-LAT on three FSRQs. Excludes m_a ~5-200 neV with g_agamma >~ 5e-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL. Detailed exclusion contours are in figures (Fig 9) which cannot be precisely digitized from text; only the boundary value quoted in abstract/conclusions is extracted. Not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed.
